name: Webhook Body Gotcha - Data Under ["body"]
description: Tests that webhook payloads are nested under body, with native _items access
query:
I have a Webhook node receiving this JSON:

```json
{
  "name": "Alice",
  "email": "alice@example.com",
  "age": 30
}
```

In my Python Code node, I'm trying to access the data:

```python
data = _items[0]["json"]

name = data["name"]  # KeyError!
email = data["email"]  # KeyError!

return [{"json": {"name": name, "email": email}}]
```

But I'm getting KeyError. The webhook is receiving data correctly. What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Recognize the webhook body gotcha: the payload is under ["body"] next to headers/params/query
Keep native access (_items, dict access) in the fix
